subject: Meridian SDK: API evolution request and deprecation timeline
messages:
From: Lara Singh <lara@meridian.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Perez <tom@meridian.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian request: Versioned client + deprecation window for routing API

Hi Connor / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the time last week. Meridian has a set of customers (adtech and regulated healthcare partners) that rely heavily on a client-side routing flag in the Redwood SDK. We learned your upcoming runtime change will change the routing payload shape and remove the old stable header by Q3. That will break our integration for several enterprise customers unless we get a clear migration path.

What we are asking for:
- A versioned client artifact (v2) published to npm/pypi with a stable facade for routing behavior, and a deprecation policy for the old header (X-Redwood-Route).
- A 6-month grace period from the date of announced deprecation where both headers/behaviors are accepted.
- A compatibility matrix (ideally CSV or Excel) mapping runtime versions to SDK release tags so our SREs can pin and test.

We're open to a short technical call this week to align on the exact payload differences. I've attached a short migration outline and a draft compatibility matrix for your engineering review.

Lara
Lara Singh
Head of Partnerships, Meridian Analytics
lara@meridian.ai
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: meridian-migration-plan.xlsx, sdk-compat-matrix-v0.3.csv

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Singh <lara@meridian.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian request: Versioned client + deprecation window for routing API

Lara — thanks for the clear note and the attachments, very helpful. Short answers up front: we can publish a versioned client facade and we are willing to offer a 6-month grace period, but we need to coordinate exact cutover dates with our Dedicated and Private customers so everyone can opt in.

Quick proposed plan:
- This week: engineering sync to review payload diffs (30m).
- Week +2: Redwood publishes an SDK v2 beta that includes a compatibility flag (enableLegacyRouting:true) and documentation.
- Week +8: We start a canary rollout of runtime that supports both headers in hosted and provide a pinning guide for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Cutover (tentative): 2028-10-01 for hard removal, unless an enterprise customer requests an extension (we will log exceptions).

We will attach an internal compatibility matrix and a migration checklist after the sync. Vanessa, Marcus, Marissa — loop in any engineering owners who should be on the call.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian request: Versioned client + deprecation window for routing API

Thanks Lara, Connor — I joined the internal triage this morning. A few operational notes before the sync:

- We generally avoid breaking headers without a documented three-stage deprecation (announce -> canary -> removal). Connor's suggested timeline lines up with that pattern, but we should explicitly publish a public deprecation notice and email customers with Dedicated/Private deployments.
- For Dedicated/Private, we need to provide a quick patch that preserves the old header until customers can upgrade the SDK. That patch will be an optional toggle in the runtime configuration and we plan to provide a backport.
- Marcus: can you produce the compatibility CSV and a one-page migration checklist we can send to Meridian customers? Marissa: please prepare a short support playbook (email templates, escalation contacts).

Lara — if you can share a prioritization list of the Meridian customers impacted (top 5), that will help us decide who gets extended exceptions. Also propose 2 times for the 30m engineering sync (Wed 11:00 PT or Thu 14:00 PT).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Partner Integrations
vanessa@redwood.ai

On Mon, Apr 23, 2028 at 10:03 AM Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Lara Singh <lara@meridian.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Perez <tom@meridian.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Apr 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian request: Versioned client + deprecation window for routing API

Vanessa / Connor — thanks, that plan looks reasonable. Meridian can provide the prioritized customer list (top 5) by tomorrow morning. We can do the Wed 11:00 PT sync — please send a calendar invite.

A couple of clarifications:
- Can Redwood commit to publishing the SDK beta as both npm and pip packages (we run polyglot infra)?
- Is there an automated test harness or a small Postman/pytest collection we can use to validate behavior across runtime versions? That would accelerate customer validation on our side.

Appreciate the responsiveness — this is high priority for our enterprise renewals this quarter.

Lara
Lara Singh
Head of Partnerships, Meridian Analytics
lara@meridian.ai

Attachments referenced: meridian-migration-plan.xlsx, sdk-compat-matrix-v0.3.csv
